results.title: Region7W_StoryMap_Ch3_RoadwaysAndBridges
results.description: This is a point displayed dataset of in-service bridge locations throughout Minnesota. Data is gathered from bridge construction plans, inspection reports, load ratings and clearance forms prepared by all Minnesota agencies that own and maintain structures. This data is exported daily from the Structure Information Management System (SIMS) and included in the feature class attribute table. The Data is maintained by the Bridge Inventory Management Unit located at the MnDOT Bridge Office. The attribute table currently contains the following data:Bridge Number, Latitude/Longitude, UTM X/Y, Location Description, MnDOT District, County, Service Description, Year Built, Owner, On/Under Information, AADT/HCAADT, Bridge Type, Bridge Length, Bridge Width, Open/Posted/Closed Status, Load Postings, NBI Ratings/Overall Condition Rating, Scour Code, and Bridge Clearances.

This overlay layer merges the results of the above-average DVC calculation and DVC concentration aggregation. By combining these datasets, the layer provides a comprehensive view of both the frequency and spatial distribution of DVCs, allowing for a more nuanced analysis of high-risk areas, giving us three specific points. 
Source:
Average DVC Layer (derived from DVC dataset, 2022).
DVC Concentration Aggregate Points Layer (derived from DVC dataset, 2022).
Date Accessed: November 2024.
Purpose: To visualize DVC risk with enhanced detail, facilitating informed decisions for corridor implementation.

results.name: Shoreview_Streets
results.title: All Streets
results.description:
Section 1: Identification

  • Originator: City of Shoreview
  • Title: All Streets
  • Abstract: This dataset provides a routable network of federal, state, county, municipal, and private roads within the City of Shoreview. It represents the driving surfaces of the roads, generally placed near the center of the road pavement. Where pavement is divided by a median or raised divider of more than 50 feet, a separate feature represents the pavement in each direction (a dual carriageway representation). The center of the physical roadway pavement may not necessarily represent the center of the road right-of-way, which may taper or change width.
  • Purpose: This dataset provides a routable street network with address attribution appropriate for geocoding. Many of the attributes were specifically included to support the Ramsey County Computer-Aided Dispatch system.
  • Time Period of Content Date: 2026
  • Progress: Completed
  • Maintenance and Update Frequency: As-Needed
  • Spatial Extent of Data: City of Shoreview, MN
  • Access Constraints: None
  • Use Constraints: See “Terms of Use”
  • Contact Person: 
    Jonathan Mortensen, GIS Coordinator
    City of Shoreview
    4600 Victoria St N
    Shoreview, MN 55126
    Phone: 651.490.4656
    Email: jmortensen@shoreviewmn.gov
  • Contact Organization: City of Shoreview

Section 2: Data Quality

Attribute Accuracy: Accuracy limited by compiled information from Ramsey County “Streets” and MnDOT's AADT datasets.

Logical Consistency: Free of overshoots and undershoots.

Completeness: The dataset includes all public roads and many private roads open to the general public. It generally excludes private sections of pavement serving fewer than three households (considered private drives). The road centerline does not attempt to conform to right-of-ways that are not parallel or alter in width.

Horizontal Positional Accuracy: 30 +- 5 ft

Lineage: The core schema of this dataset was generated from the Ramsey County OpenData "Streets" layer. This schema was subsequently modified and merged to include attribute fields from three additional sources: the City of Shoreview's “Streets Simple” dataset, GoodPointe Technology's “Shoreview City Streets” dataset, and MnDOT's “AADT Road Centerlines” dataset.

Section 3: Spatial Data Organization

Spatial Object Type: Vector (Line)

Section 4: Spatial Reference Information

  • Horizontal Coordinate Scheme:  NAD 1983 HARN Adj MN Ramsey (US Feet)
  • UTM Zone Identifier: 15
  • Horizontal Datum: NAD83
  • Horizontal Units: U.S survey feet

Section 5: Attributes

Entity and Attribute Overview: Entity and Attribute Overview: This dataset contains line features representing road centerlines with a highly detailed composite schema drawn from four primary sources:

  • Routing & Dispatch (from Ramsey County Streets): Fields supporting geocoding, dispatch, and routing include RouteSystem, RouteDirection, DirectionalRouteID, LocalState, PrimaryStatus, RouteName, RouteNumber, AltName1, AltName2, AltName3, LeftFromAddress, RightFromAddress, LeftParity, RightParity, LeftZIP, RightZIP, LeftCityID, RightCityID, LeftCountyID, RightCountyID, LeftPoliceID, RightPoliceID, LeftFireID, RightFireID, FromElevation, ToElevation, OneWay, ImpedenceSpeed, EmergencyAccessOnly, and PostedSpeed.
  • City Maintenance (from Shoreview Streets Simple): Fields supporting local maintenance activities include F_XST, R_XST, F_CLASS, TYPE, FlushingZone, CrackSealZone, and Surface_Type.
  • Asset Management (from GoodPointe Shoreview City Streets): Fields detailing road jurisdiction and physical characteristics include UNISEC, CTYLABRV, CTYRABRV, HIGHWAY_NU, TLGID, Road_Type, Road_Juris, NO_LANES, FUN_CLASS, and Width.
  • Traffic Volumes (from MnDOT AADT Centerlines): Fields detailing Annual Average Daily Traffic include SEQUENCE_NUMBER, ROUTE_LABEL, LOCATION_DESCRIPTION, VEHICLE_CLASS_NUMBER, CURRENT_YEAR, CURRENT_VOLUME, AADT_COMMENTS, DAILY_FACTOR_GROUP, SEASONAL_FACTOR_GROUP, AXLE_FACTOR_GROUP, and DATA_TYPE.
